challenge.method: I checked the exact 17.0 command-reference source against the stamp and read the INHERITS syntax, the persistent-parent description and nearby conflicting and merging declarations. https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/d7ec59a63d745ba74fba0e280bbf85dc6d1caa3e
challenge.results: The reference makes INHERITS optional, says the child automatically receives parent columns and describes an ongoing parent link. Duplicate names can cause type errors or merge into one child column, consistent with the claim’s limits.

limitations: The evidence describes the documented command behavior at the 17.0 stamp. Constraint inheritance, column merge/default rules, and subsequent propagation have additional rules.
